reviews.text:
Richi is my 13-year-old Yorkshire Terrier, and we've been going to IVEM for quite some time now. During this time, he's had cataract surgery with lens replacement and also a dental cleaning with extraction of damaged teeth. These have been very nerve-wracking moments, but the team has always given me what I needed most: the peace of mind of knowing my dog ​​was in good hands.

I want to thank everyone: the reception staff, the veterinarians, the anesthesiologists, the nursing staff, and every single person who cares for Richi before, during, and after each procedure. Everything runs like clockwork, and at the same time, you can see the care and attention they put into their work. Richi receives excellent care, and I can breathe much easier.

The surgeries, the aftercare, the consultations… Everything has been top-notch, and I only have words of gratitude.

In these 13 years with Richi, I've met many veterinarians and visited clinics in different countries, so I can compare. The professionalism and the care at IVEM are on another level. Thank you for taking such good care of my Richi. I'm so glad I found you. I recommend the clinic 1000000%! ❤️
Good professionals

Excellent service.
Ophthalmologist Marcel Castro Reyes is very kind and professional, and his clear explanations give me a lot of confidence in my Chapo's treatment.
The receptionists are very attentive (and beautiful).
In conclusion, 10/10.
Thank you so much. 🐶🐶🐶🐶🐶🐶

I'm very satisfied with the treatment I received from all the professionals at the clinic. They arrived at a diagnosis that my usual clinic was unaware of. Chloe needed a tooth extraction and cleaning, and they gave us guidelines for follow-up and maintenance to keep the condition under control and prevent it from worsening. Thank you to the entire team for caring about Chloe's health.
They are very professional and provide excellent service, both to pets and their owners.

I have no words to express my deep gratitude to Marcos and his entire team at IVEM for the incredibly professional and personal care my two dogs, Napoleon and Tommy, receive.

In fact, Marcos and his team saved the life of my dog ​​Tommy, who is a part of my whole life. Marcos is not only a great Veterinary Ophthalmologist, but he is also a person with wonderful qualities as a human being, which makes his interactions with pets and their owners truly special. And it's not just him; his entire team at IVEM responds with absolute professionalism and a truly remarkable level of human kindness.

And what can I say about Dunia? She is in charge of managing and coordinating appointments daily, at every moment. Her professionalism, kindness, and understanding of each situation allow her to provide us with unconditional support so that our beloved pets receive the care they need at the right time. IVEM is a 10 out of 10 in every aspect.

Hello, we took our pet in and they couldn't treat her because she wouldn't let them put a muzzle on her, and they wanted to charge us 170 euros, supposedly for the consultation. This is completely unacceptable.

Very friendly, kind, and professional service.
Maite and her team are excellent professionals.
The clinic is welcoming and cheerful. The surgery went exactly as they described it to and was a success.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Vanessa.
Thank you very much for your feedback, Alexander.
Thank you so much for your comment and rating, Sara.
Thank you so much for your review, Pedro.

Kitty had mouth surgery less than two weeks ago and she's doing great! She recovered incredibly fast and is feeling fantastic. All the staff are so friendly and professional. I left feeling wonderful. Thank you! 🩷
Very good professionals, but also very expensive.
Anaís is a fantastic girl, so attentive and caring towards the pets and their owners. The vets are also amazing. I'm delighted with the service they provide; their experience is evident.
Excellent in every way

If it once had prestige, nothing remains. The animal died 30 hours after the procedure. The case was poorly assessed, and perhaps it's now just a matter of business rather than weighing the pros and cons. "Professionals" who are caught lying, and everyone else defends them. For me, it's a complete disappointment; a life lost due to bad decisions made by people I considered professionals.
Responding to the reply, the animal was 17 years old. There was little they could have done for him in the emergency room. We preferred him to go home with us rather than alone and scared in a cage. The anesthesia messed everything up, and he was already weak.
As advice, try to look out for the animals more and see them less as a business. A death could have been delayed if you hadn't deemed him suitable for surgery, which was supposed to improve his quality of life. If the operation, approved as safe by you, hadn't been performed, the animal would probably still be with us.
Excellent service. Great professionals.
They are a very professional team and they are always very attentive to my little one whenever I go.
Excellent service, great team, especially Marcel! Thank you so much!!

I learned of IVEM when I needed dental care for my senior French Bulldog. From reception to the very knowledgeable staff, I couldn't say enough good things about the IVEM team. I would highly recommend IVEM for any and all specialty care, they really are the best and we felt very well taken care of by them all.

Amazing place and amazing people. I took my dog ​​there because we had already been to other medical centers for something wrong with his left eye that no one could explain. They diagnosed him right away. They have all the necessary equipment and recommended emergency surgery.

Everything went perfectly. They are 100% committed to the well-being of their pets. Highly recommended.
Lovely staff and above all very professional.
We took our young cat to the dentist for a checkup. She had lost a lot of teeth. The dentist seemed very professional and experienced. The clinic is pleasant and the receptionists were friendly.

I want to express my sincerest gratitude to the entire team at the IVEM clinic for the extraordinary care our beloved cat, Aria, received.

From the very first moment, they made us feel supported and listened to. The dentist dedicated nearly an hour to explaining Aria's condition in detail, answering each of our questions with exceptional professionalism, patience, and warmth. Similarly, the anesthesiologist spent approximately 30 minutes with us, explaining the procedure and instilling a great sense of calm and confidence.
The team's human touch is on par with their professional expertise. We felt treated with a kindness and respect that far exceeded our expectations. The care was impeccable, and our overall assessment of the experience is excellent.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of Aria and for the wonderful treatment we received.

— Raúl Landete

Moving to Valencia and finding IVEM was the best thing that could have happened to our little dog, Biscuit.  She had already lost one eye due to glaucoma and inferior vet care in the US.  When the same symptoms appeared in the other eye, we rushed her to our regular vet and they sent us to IVEM.  They diagnosed the problem right away and were able to save her eye!  We can’t tell you how much we appreciate the expertise and professionalism of the team at IVEM!
They are very good professionals, Pilar attended to us from beginning to end to solve a dental problem in my dog, very good treatment and highly recommended for this specialty.

We are very grateful to the entire IVEM Valencia team for their care and professionalism. The procedure on our dog's mouth went perfectly, and they instilled a lot of confidence in us throughout the entire process. Highly recommended!

I took my dog ​​Vala in for fractures in her upper carnassial teeth. We were referred by our regular vet for advice on whether a root canal was a good option. Maite treated us, and her work was exceptional. She took all the time necessary to explain the procedure, risks, and options to us. Vala recovered wonderfully, and at her follow-up appointment, Maite made sure she knew the proper brushing technique to prevent future problems.

The treatment, attention, and dedication of Maite and the rest of the team at the clinic were outstanding.

An additional plus is that they shared all the reports and tests they performed without us even having to ask, which is a huge advantage if you need to submit them to your insurance company.
For me, it's undoubtedly the best clinic. My cat has eye problems, and this is where they've been able to address the issue and cure her.

Excellent and personalized service.

100% RECOMMENDED
Great professionals

They specialize in eyes and mouths, and they're professionals in every sense: their treatment of animals, follow-up information, and attention to detail to ensure your pet's comfort during surgery. Most importantly, the surgery results are excellent. My dog ​​Nela had to have one of her eyes removed, but everything has been great since then, as she's no longer in pain. 👌🙏 Many thanks to Dunia for her saintly patience; I sometimes bombard her with phone calls, and she just acts like nothing's wrong.

Thank you, team!!
The attention is very close, they explain everything to you perfectly. The anesthesia, the intervention... Everything has been perfect! Thank you very much!
I went years ago, and the anesthesiologist's attitude gave me a very bad feeling, as did the receptionist. I haven't been back since.

We went because of some problems with our dog's eyes, and the truth is that the care was very good; you feel that they really care about the animals, and it wasn't much more expensive than a regular clinic in town.

I was shocked by the prices! When they told me that removing a complicated tooth from a dog costs 500 euros! Are you serious? A human tooth extraction costs a maximum of 130! I only have one question! How did you come up with such prices? How is this even possible?

If you're looking for a trustworthy veterinary ophthalmologist, look no further than IVEM. Dr. Marcel treated my pug, Paquito, with exceptional professionalism and care. I especially appreciate the clarity of his explanations, the comprehensive report he provided, and the clinic's wonderfully positive and zen-like atmosphere. An excellent and very caring team. I'm very happy with the service! True professionals in veterinary ophthalmology. Congratulations and thank you for everything!
Hi Susana, thank you so much for your feedback. Best regards!
Hi María Jesús, thank you so much for your feedback. Best regards!
A very good experience both at the Ivem clinic and with its staff. Special thanks to Marcos (ophthalmology) for being a great professional, attentive, and very kind to my dog. 100% recommended.
